title: Happy Birthday, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Sometimes a well chosen gift can say more than the longest wishes. The Birthday Coin was designed as an elegant keepsake of that one special day of the year. It is a proposal for those who want to give something personal yet lasting. A moment that stays in the memory longer than others and remains with us forever, captured in pure silver.
